name: Positive Recursive Teaching Dimension / Recursive Teaching Dimension
proof: The positive recursive model requires every teaching sample used at every recursive stage to be positive.  It is therefore a restriction of the ordinary recursive model, so its optimum cannot be smaller.
witness_verification: For C_{+triangle}, positive RTD is 2 whereas ordinary RTD (equivalently finite-class PBTD) is 1; sync/verify_positive_teaching_triangle.py exhausts preference orders.
